title: Just okay...
text: Just okay.... Used this bag to throw out an old mattress, plastic was pretty thick but it ripped easily when carrying it.

product_metadata.title: Mattress Bag for Moving & Long-Term Storage - Queen Size - Enhanced Mattress Protection with Extra Thick Tear & Puncture Resistance Polyethylene (Value Pack of 2pcs)
features: The Original Cresnel Brand Extra Thick Mattress Bag - High tear and puncture resistance against rough handling during house moving process.
Size: 60x14x98 inches. Easily cover all QUEEN variations including XL and pillow-top up to 14” thick.
Unlike flat 2D bag, Cresnel bag open into 3D shaped to fit your mattress snugly.
Extra length allows complete envelopment of whole mattress with overlapping end flap. It can then be sealed tight with packaging tape to keep out dust and moisture.
Improved Design – No vent holes. Excellent for long term storage, keep your mattress in the condition as before.
description: The original extra thick mattress bag that protects your mattress during moving and in storage. Bag size is specifically made larger than typical mattress to allow complete coverage and envelopment of whole mattress. Use packaging tape to seal tight, keep out dust and moisture. High tear and puncture resistance give you the peace of mind that your valuable mattress will stay protected in long term storage.
